title: NewcastleLRSIM input field
description: One controllable input value. Every value the model consumes that is not read from an immutable raw download is described by this object. The sweep rule of proposal 8.1 is enforced here as a schema constraint rather than a convention: a value that is not directly observed and is not definitional MUST carry a sweep.

value.description: The point value. NULL when status is 'unobtained' - the resolver refuses to return a point value for those and returns the sweep instead, so an unobtained input cannot be silently pinned (DECISIONS.md 0, 13).

units.description: Explicit units, per the CLAUDE.md units rule. Use 'dimensionless', 'probability', 'ratio' or 'enum' where there is no physical unit.

source.description: observed = read directly from a raw download. measured = computed from observed data in this package. derived = follows from another registry field by identity. literature = a published value not specific to this city. assumed = chosen without direct empirical support. definition = fixed by the formulation, not an empirical quantity.

sweep.description: Required unless source is 'observed' or 'definition'. A bare two-element array is shorthand for an interval, kept for compatibility with params/C2-C4.

sweep_basis.description: How the range was arrived at. An observed spread is worth more than a chosen interval and must say so.

status.description: active = usable point value. unobtained = the datum does not exist in the package and must be swept, never pinned. placeholder = a structural stand-in awaiting a real value; the model runs but the field is not defensible. computed = written by a build script at run time from other fields; do not hand-edit.

decisions_ref.description: Section of DECISIONS.md carrying the rationale. Required for every assumed value by proposal 8.1.

consumers.description: Scripts that read this field. GENERATED by the resolver's read log - do not hand-maintain.

legacy_symbol.description: The module-level constant this field replaced, as file.py:SYMBOL. Kept so the migration is auditable.

targets.description: For a constrained field: the observed quantity it is solved against (DECISIONS.md 8.5).

held_fixed.description: An alternative to a sweep, for a value the project has decided may NOT be tuned. DECISIONS.md 8.5 holds the mode constants fixed because calibrating them would fit away the effect under test (proposal 9, ASC absorption). Recording that as a rule is honest; inventing a sweep interval for a parameter nobody may move is not.

departure_requires.description: What must happen before this value may change.

baseline_ref.description: For a field with status 'unobtained': where the baseline sweep point lives, e.g. 'params/C1_sensitivity_sweep_grid.csv:is_baseline'. The baseline is a row of the sweep grid, NOT a value on the field, so an unobtained input cannot acquire a point value by being read.

matsim_param.description: The MATSim config path this field writes to, as module.param or module.parameterset[key].param. A selector of [*] means the field's own value supplies the membership: one parameterset per key of a dict, or per member of a list. Several comma-separated targets are allowed when one decision writes to more than one parameter. src/registry/param_config.py BUILDS the config from these bindings, so a parameter no field claims does not exist - which is what makes zero hardcoding checkable rather than aspirational. A field whose units differ from the parameter's is an ERROR, not a conversion: an exponent bound to a factor and a time ratio bound to a util/hour rate were both found this way.

matsim_format.description: Set only where MATSim's parameter format differs from the field's declared units - a clock time or a duration, declared in hours or seconds because that is what it is, and read by MATSim as hh:mm:ss. The conversion uses the field's own `units`, so a field cannot say hours in one place and be treated as seconds in another. Without this the config template held a second representation of the value (the literal `30:00:00` beside a field declaring 30), which is the drift the registry exists to stop.

pt2matsim_osm_param.description: The pt2matsim OsmConverter config path this field writes to. Same grammar as matsim_param; a different tool, so a different binding.

pt2matsim_mapper_param.description: The pt2matsim PublicTransitMapping config path this field writes to. Same grammar as matsim_param.

derived_from.description: For source 'derived': the value is IMPLIED by other registry fields and has no range of its own. Neither a sweep nor a held_fixed rule fits - inventing a sweep for a value that is not free would be the fabrication proposal 8.1 exists to prevent. State the identity instead.

identity.description: The relation, in words or as an expression.
